Name: Igor's Anime Portrait for Pam
Author: IGor1B
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]This is my second mod posted on Nexus and there are still many shortcomings. If I receive your support, I promise to improve the quality of the portraits.
AI-generated portrait
Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 
OR
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] (optional)
You can use this portrait to use with Romanceable Pam mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking For Love[/url],[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366]Siv's Marriage Mod[/url], …
[img]https://i.ibb.co/jzkpPnY/image.png[/img]
[size=5][b][color=#f1c232]HD Portraits[/color][/b]
[/size]
- Install the latest version of SMAPI
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19589][size=5]Igor's Anime Portraits for SDV NPCs[/size][/url] and required mods into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder
- Install the required mods listed into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder
- Download and Unzip the zip file 
- Drag and drop folder named [i][size=3][CP] [/size][/i][size=3][i]Igor's Anime Portraits[/i][/size] into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder
- Replace
[color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Portraiture,[/b][b] Android[/b][/size] [/color]

If you’re using Portraiture or are an [color=#00ff00][b][u]Android[/u][/b][/color] user, follow these steps:
- Ensure your Android game version supports mods. You can check this by verifying that SMAPI is successfully installed.
- Create a new folder (if it doesn’t exist already) and name it “[size=3][i]Igor’s Anime Portraits[/i][/size]”.
- Place this folder in the following path: \Mods\Portraiture\Portraits. If done correctly, the portrait file of "[u][size=4][b]Emily[/b][/size][/u]" for [u]example[/u] should be located at:\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\[size=3]Igor’s Anime Portraits[/size]\Emily.png.[img]https://i.ibb.co/GQKJG3Z/image.png[/img]
Many thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/158930453][size=5]Azzleid[/size][/url] for all his help![/font]
